name: pstack skills (community port)
description: Community port of pstack, Lauren Tan's skill pack for rigorous agent work, with five skills by Matt Pocock. Installs the skills for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor and Grok, and runs delegated work on the agent's own subagents, or on Orca workers when it needs another model, its own worktree or a longer-lived session.
